title: How 50,000 People Surged Into a Spanish Exclave in Africa
summary_full: On Thursday, tens of thousands of Moroccans broke into Ceuta, a Spanish territory that neighbors Morocco. By Friday evening, most of them had left, hungry and disappointed.
